morgan_price.name: Morgan Price (Europe) ApS
seed_facts: Morgan Price was formed in 1999 as a product provider in the international healthcare insurance market.
Morgan Price (Europe) ApS was formed in 2020 to support EU partners and members.
Morgan Price (Europe) ApS describes itself as an MGA/MGU rather than an insurer.
Morgan Price (Europe) ApS states that it is authorised and regulated in Denmark by the Danish Financial Supervisory Authority (DFSA), FTID 36351.
